from pathlib import Path
import tempfile
import torch
import pytest
from Models import BasicModel
from util import init_device
from test_generation_catalog import test_normal_supervised_output_respects_gradient_contract
init_device('cpu')
walk=BasicModel._output_generate_walk
def observed_walk(self,*args,**kwargs):
    out=walk(self,*args,**kwargs)
    p=self.question_conditioners[str(self.conceptualSpace.stm.concept_dim)].weight
    for name,value in [('first_emission',out[0][:,0].square().sum()),('all_emissions',out[0].square().sum())]:
        g=torch.autograd.grad(value,p,retain_graph=True,allow_unused=True)[0]
        print('CONDITIONER_GRADIENT',name,None if g is None else float(g.norm()),flush=True)
    print('EMITTED',out[1].tolist(),'TRUNCATED',out[2].tolist(),flush=True)
    return out
BasicModel._output_generate_walk=observed_walk
with pytest.MonkeyPatch.context() as patch:
    test_normal_supervised_output_respects_gradient_contract(Path(tempfile.mkdtemp()),patch,True)
